description: This file implements a linewise diff algorithm in Go, defining data structures and functions for computing and representing differences between text lines.

classes.name: Chunk
classes.description: Represents a diff chunk with added, deleted, and equal lines.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the diff chunk has no added, deleted, or equal lines.

methods.name: Diff
methods.description: Generates a unified diff string from two input strings.

methods.name: DiffChunks
methods.description: Computes the minimal edit chunks to transform one list of lines into another using a shortest-edit-script algorithm.
